title: Fill the in-place ranking helper under its mutation contract

acceptance.independent: reference.py computes the expected order with Python's own stable sort; the probe reads the result through the caller's binding, so a copy-and-return helper fails

notes: ranking.my is an unfinished typed hole (`todo[None]()`); `mylang check` reports E_TYPED_HOLE with a typed-hole-obligation record and every command that would run the program refuses until it is filled. The declared contract is effects(mutation) mutates(readings), so the caller's list must hold the result.
